test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. If you feel Options A, B, or C do not improve the sentence, then choose Option D: “No improvement required.”

We must __take the bull by the head__ and resolve all pending issues if we want progress.

options.text: take the bull by the tail
pull the bull by its ears
take the bull by the horns

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. take the bull by the horns .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **“take the bull by the horns”** is an idiom that means to confront a difficult or challenging situation directly and boldly.
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase **“take the bull by the head”** is incorrect, as it does not align with the conventional idiom.
 
• Option 3, **“take the bull by the horns”**, is the correct replacement that improves the sentence while preserving its intended meaning.

Correct sentence: *We must take the bull by the horns and resolve all pending issues if we want progress.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Idioms are expressions or phrases that have figurative meanings different from their literal interpretation.
 
• Other incorrect options:
 
 
• **Option 1:** "Take the bull by the tail" is not a recognized idiom.
 
• **Option 2:** "Pull the bull by its ears" is also not an established idiom.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "No improvement required" is incorrect because the original phrase needs correction for clarity and accuracy.
